rules.title: Meaningful exit codes
rules.text: Exit with 0 on success and a non-zero code on failure.

rules.title: Output streams
rules.text: Write results to stdout and diagnostics to stderr.

rules.title: Helpful --help
rules.text: Provide --help with usage examples for every command.

rules.title: Machine-readable output
rules.text: Offer a --json flag for scripted use and keep default output human friendly.

rules.title: Non-interactive mode
rules.text: Support non-interactive use with flags and never block on prompts in CI.

rules.title: Dry run for destructive actions
rules.text: Offer --dry-run and require confirmation for destructive actions.
